extension.description: Switch and manage multiple Codex accounts
configuration.title: Codex Switch
configuration.activeProfileScope.descrip: Where to store active profile selection
configuration.storageMode.description: Where profile credentials are stored. In auto mode, SSH remote sessions use a shared remote file store and local sessions use SecretStorage
configuration.reloadWindowAfterProfileSw: Restart the VS Code extension host after successful profile switch/import; fall back to reloading the window so the Codex extension re-reads auth.json
configuration.codexCliPath.description: Path to the Codex CLI binary used for account rate limits. Leave empty to auto-detect
configuration.rateLimitAutoRefreshInterv: How often Codex account rate limits refresh automatically in the background. This also keeps saved Codex authentication current when Codex rotates it. Set to 0 for manual refresh only
configuration.autoSwitchOnRateLimit.desc: Automatically switch to another saved Codex profile when the active account reaches its configured usage threshold
configuration.autoSelectNearestResetOnSt: At VS Code startup, automatically select the usable saved Codex account whose next known quota reset is closest, so quota that would reset sooner is consumed first
configuration.autoSwitchThresholdPercent: Fallback usage percentage that triggers automatic switching for rate-limit windows other than the dedicated 5-hour and weekly windows
configuration.autoSwitch5hThresholdPerce: Usage percentage that triggers automatic switching for the 5-hour Codex rate-limit window
configuration.autoSwitchWeeklyThresholdP: Usage percentage that triggers automatic switching for the weekly Codex rate-limit window
Usage percentage below which a recently abandoned account becomes eligible again. It is also released after the triggering rate-limit window resets
configuration.autoSwitchDeferUntilSafe.d: Queue the automatic account switch instead of immediately restarting the extension host. Recommended to avoid interrupting an active Codex response; apply the pending switch after the current turn finishes
Minimum time between automatic account switches, used to prevent rapid switching loops
configuration.statusBarClickBehavior.des: Behavior when clicking the status bar profile item
configuration.statusBarClickBehavior.tog: Toggle between current and previous profile
configuration.codexHome.enabled.descript: Keep active and previous profile selection separate for each CODEX_HOME that VS Code was launched with
configuration.codexHome.inheritDefaultPr: When CODEX_HOME-scoped state is enabled, inherit the default CODEX_HOME active profile only if the current CODEX_HOME has no auth.json yet
